title: [spec-gap][R-04-025] C gateway lacks mesh-to-internet multicast egress drop (spec 04 6.3.4)
description:
Spec spec/04-network.md 6.3.4 MUST: Border routers MUST NOT forward mesh multicasts to the internet. Table row 'Mesh -> Internet | Multicast | Drop' (internet->mesh row has an explicit-config exception; the mesh->internet row has none).

Evidence:
- Python: implemented+tested. python/src/lichen/routing/router.py:491-497 BR multicast filter (both directions unless multicast_peering_enabled); tests python/tests/routing/test_router.py:522-635; vector test/vectors/br_multicast_filter.json.
- Rust: implemented+tested. rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:60 (config), :965 (peering gate), :1770 ('upstream multicast destination dropped (spec 04 6.3.4)'); test rust/lichen-gateway/tests/end_to_end.rs:567 upstream_multicast_dropped_without_multicast_peering.
- C: divergent/not-implemented for mesh->internet egress. lichen/apps/gateway/src/forwarding.c lichen_forwarding_handle() (155-226) gates egress only on tunnel auth + MTU; no multicast destination check. lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c:627-640 covers only backbone->mesh ingress (crosses_boundary drop). A mesh-originated multicast handed to the Zephyr IP forwarder toward the backhaul iface passes the NPF egress gate (forwarding.c:82-107) unfiltered.

Suggested placement: extend lichen_forwarding_handle() (or the router.c local-ingress multicast decision at router.c:641-645, which currently DELIVER_AND_FORWARDs scope>=2 without an external egress distinction) to drop multicast egress to the backbone iface unless an explicit peering config exists; mirror the multicast_peering flag already present in router.h:148-149.
